# go-localereader license provenance

Mole's Go module graph pins `github.com/mattn/go-localereader` at `v0.0.1`.
The [tagged README](https://github.com/mattn/go-localereader/blob/v0.0.1/README.md)
identifies the project as MIT-licensed and names Yasuhiro Matsumoto as author,
but that version's module archive contains no license file. The accompanying
`LICENSE` is copied verbatim from the same upstream project at
[commit `6bae6c923850ab5e0da9f36f69811ffe17064228`](https://github.com/mattn/go-localereader/blob/6bae6c923850ab5e0da9f36f69811ffe17064228/LICENSE),
which added the full MIT terms after the tagged version.

The packaging script supplies this notice only when the vendored module list
contains that exact version and no `LICENSE` file is already present. Recheck
the provenance and notice when updating the dependency.
